top_comments.text:
Where does GROUND BEEF rank among your favorite animal proteins—🥇1, 🥈2, 🥉3, or lower? Drop your number below, then tell me your favorite way to prepare it! 👇

Ribeye gets the photo shoot. Ground beef gets dinner done. 😄

Here are the key sources behind this episode:

🥩 Ground beef versus ribeye nutrition
USDA nutrient database. We compared equal cooked weights—not equal raw portions. Values vary with the cut, fat content, and preparation.
https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/usda-national-nutrient-database-for-standard-reference-legacy-release

🔬 Minced beef versus steak: protein digestion
Pennings et al., 2013. In 10 older men, minced beef was digested and absorbed faster, but muscle protein synthesis did not significantly differ. This does NOT prove ground beef builds more muscle.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23636241/

⚙️ Meat-grinder history
An original 1845 patent documents improvements to a sausage-meat cutter—not an established “first invention” of ground beef.
https://patents.google.com/patent/US3935

🍽️ USDA beef grades
Prime describes eating quality, including marbling—not overall nutritional superiority.
https://www.ams.usda.gov/grades-standards/beef/shields-and-marbling-pictures

🌡️ Ground-beef safety
Cook to 160°F using a thermometer. Color alone cannot establish safety.
https://www.fsis.usda.gov/food-safety/safe-food-handling-and-preparation/meat/ground-beef-and-food-safety

You don’t need a premium steak budget to put useful protein and nutrients on your plate. Keep protecting your NEST!

My favorite ground beef meal is burgers with chicken liver and onion gravy. I season the burgers with s&p, dried thyme and garlic. Cook them most of the way through and remove them from the pan. top_comments.text: I've been putting off buying an air fryer because so many of them are plastic and because of the coatings on the baskets. Trying to find the best model that is 100% plastic Free. I have a air fryer lid for my instant pot that was given to me as a gift and have to admit that it has stayed in the box and I've never tried it out. My bad. LOL several years ago I had what was probably considered an air fryer before actual air fryers came out. It was a large heat proof glass container with a convection lid on the top. I loved using it because the glass vessel had a separate lid and could be used to store leftovers and the whole thing was big enough to do a large chicken or roast in the temperature was quite variable. It was also deep enough that you could put vegetables in the bottom to roast and use a elevated rack for a piece of meat so that the juices from that meat drip down onto the veggies. One of my favorite things to do was onions and garlic in the bottom underneath a chuck roast or a spatchcocked chicken. It was a good design except for one flaw. The thing worked great until it burned out because the design made it so fats directly deposited on the heating coils. They eventually redesigned it so that didn't happen but I never purchased another one. I do use my countertop convection oven as a sort of air fryer but it's not quite the same thing. If I can't find a air fryer that I like and doesn't have plastic or toxic Coatings then I might look for the updated version of that other one that I had.
top_comments.author: @decolonizeEverywhere
